title: PERSISTENT CAMP IDENTITY SHOWCASE
description: The update treats combat feel and monetization pressure as one shared pacing problem. Player camps now preserve trophies, naming, and small visual scars from completed seasonal events. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: The base started looking like a home instead of a storage error with rugs. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.

title: PERSISTENT CAMP IDENTITY FOUNDATION
description: The feature moves a player-facing convenience into the same room as a business goal. Player camps now preserve trophies, naming, and small visual scars from completed seasonal events. Several improvements focus on crash fixes, save safety, and boring reliability instead of visible beats.
consequence: The base started looking like a home instead of a storage error with rugs. The game improved in ways that make terrible thumbnails.

title: CLEAN SLATE SEASONING SHOWCASE
description: The update makes the game easier to explain from the outside, with consequences for those still inside. Old progression hooks have been flattened so returning players can experience the new season from a more equal baseline. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: Everyone started together, especially the people who had already finished. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.
